ABOUT_DESC: A lightweight proxy client supporting SOCKS5 / HTTP / HTTPS, featuring rule-based routing, real-time traffic monitoring, and GeoIP identification.
AUTHOR: Author
SETTINGS_PROXY_DESC: Local listening port and upstream proxy.
SETTINGS_NETWORK_DESC: Bind addresses and DNS servers, one per row.
SETTINGS_ROUTING_DESC: Traffic from these regions connects directly.
UDP_MODE_HINT: Off: reject SOCKS5 UDP ASSOCIATE. Direct: UDP always leaves via the local network. Proxy: UDP follows routing rules through the server (falls back to direct if the server lacks UDP support).
CONFIRM_SAVE_PROMPT: Configuration will be saved and the app restarted to apply changes. Continue?
ERR_10048: Port is already in use by another application. Please close it and try again.
ERR_1: Configuration file "setting.json" not found. Please reinstall the application.
ERR_2: GeoIP database "GeoDB.dat" not found. Please reinstall the application.
